description.value: Breka Bakery & Café is a Vancouver family business that has operated 24 hours a day, 7 days a week since 2006, making it one of the few food stops reliably available to cyclists at any hour of the day or night. The West Hastings location is one of eight across the city, offering fresh-baked European-influenced pastries, artisan breads, sandwiches, and a broad selection of hot beverages. The bakery has been regularly voted among Vancouver's best and also supplies catering to film production crews in the city.
